item.title: Build an Excel Pay Fixation Calculator Under CCS (Revised Pay) Rules Using a Pay Matrix
item.description:
Build an Excel Pay Fixation Calculator Using the Pay Matrix

Pay fixation after promotion is one of the most frequently performed calculations in Government offices. Although the rules are straightforward, manually comparing both fixation options is time-consuming and often leads to mistakes.

This guide explains how to create an Excel-based Pay Fixation Calculator that automatically calculates both permissible options under the revised pay rules and recommends the financially better option.

item.title: Complete Beginner's Guide to Pranali IFMS (DDO) - Sanction Orders, Bill Preparation, Salary Bills & Top Sheet Generation in Sikkim
item.description:
Complete Beginner’s Guide to Pranali IFMS (DDO)

The Pranali Integrated Financial Management System (IFMS) is the online financial management platform used by the Government of Sikkim for budget management, sanction orders, bill preparation, treasury processing, salary bills, and payments.

This guide explains the complete workflow followed by a Drawing and Disbursing Officer (DDO), based on practical office procedures.

Portal

  • DDO Portal: https://ddo.pranali.sikkim.nic.in
  • Treasury/RCO Portal: https://rco.pranali.sikkim.nic.in
